scope: XombieSub parser policy and record assembly in safe Rust through the experimental document owner; complete library migration remains active.

operations.operation: Owned XombieSub state, style and dialogue assembly
operations.behavior: Raw UTF16 line/key/remainder storage, supplied-predicate trimming, false-ReadString fragment discard, comment handling, equals-key split, key dispatch, screen inference and failure reset, ordered typed fields, style defaults/normalization, full-millisecond wrapping timestamps, discarded id, D-only records, star stripping, embedded font lifecycle, acceptance from live document nonemptiness.

Actual pinned parser compiled with MSVC14.44 evaluates the right mutating GetStr operand first. Two input fields First,Second become Second_First for both named styles and dialogues. Safe Rust explicitly reproduces that order and counted CString concatenation including embedded NUL tails. Do not generalize this result to a different toolchain without direct evidence.

Native ReadString, CString IsSpace/MakeLower, GetStr/GetInt/GetFloat, Default CompareNoCase and Add/AddStyle still execute outside registry admission. The version conversion remains outside numeric-error catches. AddFontMemResourceEx receives owned decoded bytes, ignoring return/count and preserving process lifetime. The existing Add path retains final trimming, charset, callbacks and timeline policy.

boundary_review.contract: Typed never-reused run ID resolves a live document under nonblocking admission. Copy all raw input/remainder/predicate bytes before registry loans; validate command/type/shape/bools. Preflight output capacities before snapshot/run publication; immutable snapshots survive run/document release. No caller pointer, native object or callback is retained. AddStyle receives its temporary only after style snapshot copies and session acknowledgement complete. Invalid/stale IDs, BUSY and malformed protocol inputs are rejected; allocation/reentry compatibility remains unresolved.

probe.repeat: Two reference and two candidate runs per architecture, actual STS.cpp with initialized document observer. Includes pre-populated documents, field errors/NaN/extremes, raw code units, truncation, key case, EOF and fonts. Exact output, exceptions, file positions and intercepted installation bytes compared. Baseline90c3543f ran unchanged native parser in both checkouts before the port.

renderer_additions.behavior: File and memory opening; exact 1.234/4.345 second boundaries and repeat/reverse seeks; styling, raw NUL/surrogate text, final-fragment discard and embedded Abel font. Italic/control and font-attached/control must render differently.

limits: No whole-format/frontend/host closure or default production switch.
Finite local Windows x86/x64 MSVC14.44/SDK10.0.26100.0 evidence, not non-Windows parity.
No allocation failure, allocator reentry, native UI/player graph integration or Miri evidence.
Default native-document fallback retains the C++ parser; only compile probes are new for that configuration.
CString/CRT/file/encoding and Add/AddStyle adapters remain transitional native code; public hosts and vendored code remain in scope.
next_work: Continue removing native parser preparation and conversion adapters with direct source/binary comparisons.
Migrate remaining format parsers and their owned storage, then complete rendering and all host/ABI packages.
Retire obsolete raw boundaries as their native-document fallback callers are replaced.
